critical_code_review_comments: Minor: /app/memory/p9zb.js wnGreet() reads state.profile.nickname — if the user updates profile mid-session before the first game, that is fine. Documented: when seeding via localStorage for tests, you must SET localStorage BEFORE the initial page load (or call reload), otherwise state.profile loads with defaults (nickname='friend') and the greeting pool only inserts the nickname into templates containing {n}. All WN_HI templates that reference the user use {n}; those without {n} are generic ('look who pulled up 👀') — this is intentional pool design.

Minor: wcWho(song) returns an artist id string (e.g. '11', '1'), not an object. If any future test (or external code) assumes it returns {id,name}, grouping/dedup logic can silently collapse to a single bucket. Consider documenting the return shape or returning a stable record object.
test_credentials: None required for this round (frontend-only, no auth flows exercised).
seed_data_creation: Set BEFORE initial page load: localStorage.treesh_whatsnew_off='true', localStorage.treesh_profile=JSON.stringify({nickname:'Tester',birthday:'2000-01-01'}), localStorage.treesh_onboarded='true'. For the light-splash test additionally localStorage.treesh_theme=JSON.stringify('light') then reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 acceptance checks from the iteration-23 request pass. Important setup notes: (1) localStorage MUST be set before the initial document load for state.profile to pick up the nickname — set it on root '/' then goto '#/game' (or reload). (2) The onboarding/welcome modal may intercept pointer events if treesh_onboarded flag not set; dismiss by setting that flag or calling document.getElementById('modal').innerHTML=''. (3) [data-testid^=wl-song-] matches BOTH the grid container data-testid='wl-song-grid' AND individual song cards; filter it out when auto-picking a song. (4) wcWho(song) returns a string id (e.g. '11'), not an object. (5) window.state is NOT exposed as a window property but is accessible as a bare identifier inside page.evaluate (strict-mode top-level). (6) Dup-artist songs for group testing — key by wcWho(song) directly; London Llaflare (id='1') has 2+ eligible songs. (7) The group-chat bug fix is verified at both the UI level (single big avatar when all participants are the same artist) and participant uniqueness (header/start wc-av count matches unique artists). (8) Greeting pool WN_HI has 12 templates — not all contain {n}, so some starts may greet 'look who pulled up 👀' without the nickname; retry up to 5 times to see nickname-containing templates (we saw 'yo Tester! 👋' and 'Tester! been waiting on you ⏳' in test runs).
